title: Poetry Analysis — Tone and Mood
skills: distinguish tone from mood in poetry
analyze how diction and imagery create emotional effects
identify the speaker's attitude toward a subject
support interpretations of tone and mood with textual evidence
alignment_note: Introduces tone and mood within poetry analysis and explains how diction, imagery, and speaker attitude shape a poem's emotional effect. Supports close reading, poetic interpretation, author's craft analysis, and evidence-based discussion across high school English courses.
